description: Manual gates for the Collaborative VR + web accounts track (docs/BUILD_PLAN.md steps 13-29) and the guided tour bot track (steps 30-34). These are facts no script can detect (dashboard setup, on-device tests). scripts/check_collab_gates.py reads this file.
rules: An agent may set a gate to true ONLY after the user explicitly confirms it in the conversation. Never flip a gate to unblock yourself.
When setting a gate to true, fill confirmed_by (the person's role, e.g. 'user') and confirmed_on (YYYY-MM-DD).

scope_approved.meaning: The team approved the Collaborative VR + web accounts track. AGENT.md and ARCHITECTURE.md allow it as a gated, post-MVP track.

nemoclaw_agent_ready.meaning: Build Plan step 3 is done: NemoClaw runtime running, a read-only scene inspection works, and one tool-calling round trip succeeded on NEMOCLAW_MODEL_PROVIDER=meta (Muse Spark) and on xai (Grok) by changing only the env var.

account_switcher_verified.meaning: On one real Quest in SKETCHSCAPE_AUTH_MODE=demo: the account switcher shows both SKETCHSCAPE_DEMO_USERS, joins the live multiplayer session under an anonymous Unity identity tagged with the chosen account id, and each account can edit only the objects it uploaded.

two_headset_verified.meaning: Step 25 checklist passed on two real headsets plus the web app, including multi-object uploads, both hardcoded accounts editing live, and a recipient opening a letter live.

gpu_multi_object_verified.meaning: After an approved GPU run: one photo with 3 objects produced 3 PLYs, two uploads submitted together both completed, and the SKETCHSCAPE_GPU_CONCURRENCY benchmark result (or 'kept at 1') is recorded in docs/BUILD_PLAN.md step 27.

guide_live_model_verified.meaning: After explicit approval: Build Plan step 32.0's Muse Spark compatibility table and scripts/eval_guide_live.py results are recorded in docs/BUILD_PLAN.md step 32, and 100% of delivered guide turns were grounded. Required before any demo or write-up claims the guide runs live on Muse Spark.

guide_bot_verified.meaning: On one real Quest: the guide bot plays the full tour with spatial audio, reveals the hidden element, answers ask_about on every contributed object, holds 72 Hz while moving, and the room still loads correctly with no active tour.

shared_guide_verified.meaning: On two real Quests in one session: either person's ask_about is answered by the same bot, audio is heard in sync on both, and the tour continues from the same step after the session owner leaves.
